summary: Remote PTY backdoor via WebRTC/WebSocket relay
details: sextant-cli-linux-amd64 ships a Go binary that embeds a full pion WebRTC stack (pion/webrtc/v4, dtls, ice, turn, stun, sctp, datachannel), coder/websocket, and creack/pty. On execution it connects to an author-controlled signaling relay at wss://relay.sextant.top and bridges remote messages into a locally spawned PTY (bash/claude), giving a remote party a full interactive shell on the host running the tool. The binary also queries http://ip-api.com/json/ over plain HTTP to disclose the host's public IP to a third-party geolocation service, aiding remote host targeting. package.json declares the license as `SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control`, and the version is a pre-release (0.0.1-rc20) — publisher metadata and version shape are inconsistent with a mature, legitimately advertised product.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
